incidents.summary: BT was fined £2.8 million after EE and Plusnet failed to provide required contract information to at least 1.1 million customers.

sources.title: BT fined £2.8m over failures affecting 1.1 million EE and PlusNet customers | Science, Climate & Tech News | Sky News
sources.quote: BT has been fined £2.8m after EE and Plusnet failed to provide clear and simple contract information to more than a million customers.

sources.title: BT fined £2.8m over failures affecting 1.1 million EE and PlusNet customers | Science, Climate & Tech News | Sky News
sources.quote: Since June 2022, BT's EE and Plusnet businesses made more than 1.3 million sales without providing customers with a contract summary and information documents, which affected at least 1.1 million customers, according to industry watchdog, Ofcom.

sources.title: BT fined £2.8m over failures affecting 1.1 million EE and PlusNet customers | Science, Climate & Tech News | Sky News
sources.quote: It said BT got in contact with affected customers last summer and offered them the chance to request information or cancel their contract without charge.

incidents.summary: Ofcom fined BT £17.5 million after a network failure prevented nearly 14,000 attempted emergency calls from connecting.

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: On 25 June 2023, a "catastrophic failure" in BT's network resulted in nearly 14,000 attempted 999 emergency calls not being connected.

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: Ofcom fined BT £17.5 million, citing the telecom giant's lack of preparedness and poorly documented backup procedures.

incidents.summary: Ofcom fined BT £6.3 million for failing to give Eir the same fibre-service information supplied to BT's own competing team during a Northern Ireland public-sector deal.

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: In 2020, BT was fined £6.3m by the telecoms regulator Ofcom for violating the law on a large public sector deal in Northern Ireland.

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: In its report, Ofcom found that BT's network violated the rules by failing to supply Eir with the same details on its on-demand fibre-to-the-premises offering as its own rival team.

incidents.summary: BT's agreement with Phorm to analyse users' browsing data for advertising drew criticism, including disapproval from Tim Berners-Lee.

sources.title: BT Group

incidents.summary: British lawmakers criticised BT for allowing Huawei access to the UK's communications network without ministerial oversight; BT subsequently completed removal of Huawei equipment in March 2024.

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: On 7 June 2013, British lawmakers concluded that BT should not have allowed Huawei access to the UK's communications network without ministerial oversight,

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: In 2020, following a government ruling, BT began removing Huawei equipment from its broadband and mobile networks in order to comply with new restrictions on the usage of Huawei equipment.

sources.title: BT Group
sources.quote: The process was finally completed by March 2024.

positives: BT set a 1.5°C-aligned climate target approved by the Science Based Targets initiative in 2017.
